newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Orix up 2.5 pct on growth expectations.
newsitem.headline: Orix up 2.5 pct on growth expectations.

text.p: Shares of Lanka Orix Leasing Co rose 2.5 percent or five rupees to 205 in the first session of trading on Monday, brokers said.
"The company is expected to do well in 1997 on the back of easing interest rates," said a local broker.
Interest rates are seen falling this year after the Central Bank cut the reserve requirement of commercial banks by three percent, in a bid to reduce corporate borrowing costs.
"Investors also say a leasing company will benefit if corporates across the board start expanding, using low cost debt," said the broker.
